changelog:
You can now choose which guide a channel uses, and channels whose names do not match a guide can be matched by the name their playlist gives them.

WHAT CHANGED

- Guide: a channel's schedule now shows which guide it uses. "Choose a guide" (or "Change guide") lists the guides that have listings, with what each is showing now; pick one to pin it to the channel. A pinned guide stays through catalog and guide refreshes. "Unpin" gives the channel back the guide its provider named, or, if the provider named none, lets the next guide refresh match it again.
- Long-press on a live channel always offers its guide: "Open the schedule" when something is on now, "Guide…" when nothing is, so a channel with no guide can be given one.
- Guide matching: when a playlist gives a channel a second name (its tvg-name) and the channel's own name matches no guide, the second name is tried. It never moves a channel that already matched by its own name.
- After this update, the first catalog refresh of each provider takes longer than usual, once, while every channel is rewritten with the new details.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.14.1: per-provider search and its ranking, the multi-view picker's search, and the repair for an update that finds a refresh was interrupted.
